method.filtering_summary: The live search pulled 2,569 postings; 1,904 were older than 7 days, 64 were reposts of listings over 30 days old, 203 were senior or excluded titles, 141 were not target roles, 145 failed Kenya eligibility, 8 were already applied to and 37 were duplicates. ReliefWeb failed with a parse error. The automated Wellfound fetch is disabled by design, so Wellfound was read in the signed-in browser (about 85 roles loaded, 2 kept plus 1 stretch; Cloudflare check passed once). Fuzu was read in the signed-in browser (67 roles: 49 in IT, software and data plus 18 remote; 7 kept) and the MyJobMag personalised feed too (25 roles; 5 kept). No new micro1 engineering roles appeared today: the micro1 posts the live search returned were research, applied-science, tester or partner roles already reviewed yesterday. The Canonical observability role is an always-open EMEA listing (Greenhouse first published 2020) shown as evergreen. Most Jobgether leads were Europe-only and mid-level. The remote shortlist is short because few fresh junior-to-mid roles named Kenya or worldwide and had not already been shown.

stories.title: Five Grok Bots now hold full-time accounting jobs at SpaceXSI
stories.summary: xAI says five Team Bots (Provisioning, Billing, Billing Support, Cash Applications, Collections) each own an accounting job end to end, involving people only when judgment is needed; Benzinga reports invoice processing down from 24 hours to minutes and cash reconciliations in 30 minutes.
stories.why: A concrete, scoped-agent pattern (one Bot per process, human escalation) you can copy in your own automation work.

stories.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83 a share, raising $81.3 billion
stories.summary: Anthropic priced 980,000,000 Class A shares at $83.00, above the expected range, for $81.3 billion, the largest IPO on record; trading on Nasdaq as ANT is expected to begin November 19, 2026.
stories.why: The biggest AI listing ever signals how much capital is behind agentic AI and the Claude tools you code with.

stories.title: Cloudflare open-sources updated Clairic (27B) and Clairic-flash (9B) extraction models
stories.summary: Both document-extraction models, now handling images and PDFs, are open-weight on Hugging Face and on Workers AI; pricing is $0.24 per M input tokens (27B) and $0.10 per M input tokens (9B), with output tokens not charged.
stories.why: Small, cheap open-weight models for structured extraction suit the data-pipeline and LLM-integration work on your CV.

stories.title: Microsoft Foundry Dev Pack is generally available
stories.summary: A single install brings the Foundry CLI (azd ai), Foundry Skill, the VS Code toolkit and the GitHub Copilot app plugin, and the skill works with Claude Code, Cursor and other compatible coding agents.
stories.why: One-command agent tooling that works inside the coding assistants you already use.

stories.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion Series C
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs raised $5 billion in Series C funding for AI-powered drug discovery, about 75% of the dollar funding in Tech Startups' November 18 roundup; Genesis AI raised $500 million and Model ML $250 million for AI agents for financial professionals.
stories.why: Shows where the biggest AI cheques are going, including agents for finance.

stories.title: First Circle Capital closes $26 million fund for early-stage African fintechs
stories.summary: Africa Fund I will invest at pre-seed and seed in fintechs using AI, automation and data; backers include IFC, Bpifrance and FSD Africa, and African pre-seed was $46.5 million across 281 deals in 2025.
stories.why: A new source of early cash for the kind of fintech startups that hire junior engineers.

stories.title: Cassava seeks up to $1 billion to buy Nvidia chips for African AI data centres
stories.summary: Cassava Technologies is in talks with Middle East and US investors to raise up to $1 billion for GPUs and fibre/data-centre upgrades; the fundraising is not guaranteed to close, and Africa holds 0.6% of global data-centre capacity.
stories.why: Local AI compute would make building and hosting AI products in Africa cheaper and faster.

stories.title: Indeed: no AI 'jobpocalypse', but AI mentions in job postings have doubled
stories.summary: The Indeed AI Tracker rose from 3.6% of postings in September 2025 to 7.2% in September 2026, and nearly two-thirds of AI-touched job titles are outside traditional tech.
stories.why: Confirms AI skills are in growing demand, and not only at tech companies.

stories.title: US employers cited AI in 121,401 announced job cuts from January to October 2026
stories.summary: That is about 20% of announced cuts; AI accounted for 1,265 cuts in October, the lowest month of 2026, and tech led all sectors with 171,501 announced cuts through October.
stories.why: Layoff reasons are shifting away from AI, but tech remains the hardest-hit sector, so show proof of shipped work.

stories.title: Kenya sets KSh300 million capital floor for stablecoin issuers
stories.summary: CBK and CMA told crypto firms to apply for licences in a joint notice on Nov. 13; stablecoin issuers need KSh300 million paid-up capital, wallet providers KSh150 million, and payment processors using others' tokens KSh10 million.
stories.why: Licensing creates compliance-heavy fintech and payments engineering work in Nairobi.

stories.title: KCB Group nine-month profit rises 24% to Sh58.6 billion
stories.summary: Profit after tax rose to Sh58.6 billion for the nine months to September 30, 2026; assets grew 15.4% to Sh2.4 trillion and gross loans 11% to Sh1.4 trillion.
stories.why: Healthy bank earnings mean continued budgets for digital lending and mobile banking teams.
